info.title: IMS — Rwanda Intelligence Management System API
info.description:
**Classification: RESTRICTED — Authorized Personnel Only.**

Generated directly from the route handlers in `src/app/api/v1/` by
`scripts/generate-openapi.js`. Do not edit by hand — re-run the script instead.

## Auth flow
1. `POST /auth/login` — badge number + password → `access_token` + `refresh_token`
2. Send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on every other request
3. `POST /auth/refresh` rotates the pair before expiry

Each operation lists the permission it requires. Permissions are granted per role
in `src/lib/rbac.ts`; clearance level is checked separately on classified records.

post.summary: Village Leader community screening — checks a newcomer by full name or
post.description:
**Required permission:** `nid:scan:result_only`

Village Leader community screening — checks a newcomer by full name or

NID/passport number and returns ONLY clean/record-found + classification.

No identity details are ever returned at this permission level.

Name lookups are case-insensitive EXACT matches (no partial search) so the

registry cannot be enumerated. A record match logs an NID_MANUAL sighting

event; WANTED / INTERPOL_FLAGGED matches raise a CRITICAL alert to RNP.
